sql:
WITH events AS (
    SELECT session, stamp, path, search_type
    FROM activity_log
    WHERE search_type IS NOT NULL AND search_type != ''
),
with_target AS (
    SELECT e.session, e.stamp, e.path, e.search_type,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.session ORDER BY e.stamp) as event_num,
           MIN(CASE WHEN e.path IN ('/detail', '/detail/', '/complete') THEN e.stamp END) OVER (PARTITION BY e.session) as first_target
    FROM events e
),
pre_target AS (
    SELECT session, path, search_type, event_num, first_target,
           CASE WHEN stamp < first_target THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as is_pre_target
    FROM with_target
    WHERE first_target IS NOT NULL
),
session_counts AS (
    SELECT session,
           SUM(is_pre_target) as pre_target_count
    FROM pre_target
    GROUP BY session
),
min_pre_target AS (
    SELECT MIN(pre_target_count) as min_cnt
    FROM session_counts
),
sessions_with_min AS (
    SELECT session, pre_target_count
    FROM session_counts
    WHERE pre_target_count = (SELECT min_cnt FROM min_pre_target)
)
SELECT swm.session, pt.path, pt.search_type, swm.pre_target_count
FROM sessions_with_min swm
JOIN pre_target pt ON swm.session = pt.session AND pt.is_pre_target = 1
ORDER BY swm.session, pt.event_num
